events.summary: Telemar was built as a fort to defend the island and grew into a city; House Sapphire eventually moved there.
events.quote: Originally it was built as a fort to defend the island, but it grew into a city over the years.

events.summary: In the unpublished comic Planeswalkers War, Sandruu killed Grenfell Mor and Leshrac destroyed Telemar with the Grey Chime.
events.quote: Grenfell Mor was killed by Sandruu , and Telemar was destroyed when Leshrac activated the Grey Chime there.
